tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dam chos dgongs pa yang zab las/ rgyal ba zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi skong bshags na

raka dong sprug gi cho ga tshogs gnyis myur 'grub ces bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī ye/ dam chos dgongs pa yang zab rgyal ba zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi skong bshags na raka dong sprug gi cho ga ni/ lo rgyus sngon byung dang cho ga dngos so// lo rgyus ni/ sngon 'dod pa khams kyi gnas rigs na/ bram ze mkhan po dung phreng can zhes bya ba/ gos rgyan dung gi phreng ba gyon pa/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la mkhas shing*/ rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa zhig yod pa'i gan du/ rgyal bu nor ldan 'khor dang bcas pa rig pa slob tu phyin te/ lo mang du sbyangs pas mkhas par gyur nas rgyal bu'i bsam par/ da ni bdag gi gong du slob dpon las mkhas pa gzhan med pas/ 'di nyid nyams par bya'o snyam ste/ slob dpon la rgun chang blud nas myos pa na/ lcags kyi thur mas mig btsags/ lcags kyus lce drangs/ lus la rus sbal gyi khrag byugs/ mtshon rnon pos sgyid pa bregs/ bud med grib can mang pos brdzi bcag byed du bcug /lam srang ring por bskyal te chom pos bcom pa ltar byas so/ */de nas bram ze myos pa sangs pa'i tshe/ mig btsags pas lta bar ma nus/ lce drangs pas smra bar ma btub/ sgyid pa bregs pas lang ba'i mthu med/ bud med kyis brdzis pas 'gul bar ma nus/ rus sbal gyi khrag byugs pas lus la chu bur gyis khyab cing zug rngus thebs pa'i tshe/ bram zes slar bsam pas/ slob ma rgyal bus phrag dog byas pa shes te/ kye ma/ rgyal bu la bdag gis rig pa bslabs pas mkhas par gyur tshe drin lan med par 'di lta bu phod par/ da ni rgyal bu bsod nams zad cing tshe 'phos nas ngan song gnas ngan bcu drug tu kha 'khor zhing 'phags pa'i zhal mi mthong*/ byang chub kyi myu gu skam/ sems can srul por gyur te mig med/ ngag lkugs/ lus mdze can/ lhog pa sha bkra bas bldags chu bur gyis lus khyab pa/

sha za bya gcan stong gi gnas bcas te lus za ba/ rkang pa chad pa'i sdug bsngal dang ldan par gyur cig |ces yid kyis smon lam btab pas/ slob ma dam nyams pa'i chad pa dang*/ slob dpon bka' gnyan pa'i bden tshig skad cig la grub ste/ rgyal bu tshe dang bsod nams zad cing 'phos te rigs drug gi gnas su sdug bsngal dus gcig la nyams su myong ste/ dmyal ba'i gnas su rdo rje dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal/ yi dwags kyi gnas su phyi nang gi sgrib pa can/ dud 'gro'i gnas su gor ma rdo'i bar du 'tshir ba/ lha min gyi gnas su sgra gcan 'dzin ces pa lus che la ltogs pa/ lha'i gnas su dge ba'i ngang tshul zhes pa ltung ba'i sdug bsngal/ mi'i gnas su lus srul po gcer bu zhes pa bram ze'i smon lam thams cad tshang ba'i sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar skyes so// de'i tshe phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rjes kun tu bzang po dang rnam par snang mdzad gnyis bskul te/ dpal kun tu bzang pos rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis phyag na rdo rjer sprul te/ de gnyis la bka' bstsal pa/ 'dod pa khams kyi gnas ris na rgyal rigs ma rungs pa slob dpon la dam nyams pa/ da lta rigs drug gi sdug bsngal dus gcig la myong ba zhig snying rje'i yul du mchis pas khyod gnyis kyis drang bar gyis shig /ces gsungs pa'i tshe sprul pa gnyis kyis thabs gang gis 'dul zhus pas/ rdo rje sems dpa' la spyi khrus na raka dong sprug 'gyod tshangs bshags pa'i thabs dang*/ phyag na rdo rje la phan pa dang nus pa'i dbang rnams bka' bstsal te/ sems dpa' chen po de gnyis kyi lus srul po gcer bu'i gan du phyin nas na raka dong sprug 'gyod tshangs bshags pa smon lam dbang bskur dang bcas pa'i gdams pa bstan pas/ srul po de ngan song de rnams las thar te rig 'dzin gyi go 'phang rnam lnga rim gyis bgrod de byang chub chen por dbugs phyung par gyur to// gnyis pa cho ga la sbyor ba/

dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum mo// dang po sbyor ba ni/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor legs par bshams/ de'i phyi rol du dpal gtor dkar dmar gyis brgyan la/ sman/ rakta/ zhal zas/ mar me rnams brgya rtsa brgyad re byas pa dkyil 'khor phyogs rer nyer bdun re tshar du bshams/ de'i phyir phyi mchod rnams kyang ci 'byor bshams/ rtsa gsum las byang nas zhi khro'i bum mdun bskyed pa dang*/ tshogs lhag yan chad grub par bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ phyag 'tshal/ yig brgya/ bskang ba/ smon lam dang bzhi las/ dang po phyag 'tshal ba ni/ bskang rdzas rnams/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ dang*/ las sngags kyis sbyangs/ oṃ sarba pañtsa= oṃ ma hā rakta= oṃ ma hā ba lingta= rtsa gsum las byang ltar dang*/ oṃ badzra ga ṇa tsakra ma hā pū dza oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum gyis tshogs rdzas rnams dang*/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ nas/ shapada'i bar gyis phyi mchod rnams byin gyis brlabs/ sgrub po rnams khrus bya/ gos gsar pa gyon/ dri zhim pos lus byugs la phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐ */ dmigs med mkha' ltar dag cing khyab pa'i sku// spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol bar mi dmigs kyang*// thugs rje'i rang bzhin chos sku dag pa las| |ye shes sgyu mar rol cing gshegs su gsol// spros med mtha' bral chos sku kun tu bzang*// longs spyod rdzogs sku rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs// sprul pa'i sku mchog rgyal dbang padma 'byung*// rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gang la gang 'dul de la der ston cing*// sgrub pa po la dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol// yi dam rgyal ba ma lus 'dus pa'i dpal| |dbang chen rta mchog rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo// gnas dang yul gyi zhing khams kun tu rgyu// sgrub po'i grogs mdzad bar gcod dgra bgegs 'joms// legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod pa// ma sring mkha' 'gro rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// hūm̐ */

gti mug mkha' khams rnam dag pa// nas/ phyag 'tshal las kyi khro bo la// zhes pa zhi khro'i mdun bskyed kyi bstod pa ltar dang*/ hūm̐ */ gang gi phrin las thogs med cing*// las rnams sgrub pa'i mthu rtsal can// chos skyong gter bdag gter srung bcas/ srung ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo// zhes brgya phrag thems pa dkyil 'khor lnga pa'i phyag legs par btsal lo// gnyis pa yig brgya ni/ gdan la 'khod nas/ rang gi spyi bor padma dkar po dang zla ba'i gdan la hūm̐ dkar po las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ dkar pos mtshan pa las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ sangs rgyas sras bcas rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs thams cad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ de rnams kyi byin rlabs 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus/ hūm̐ la thim zhing slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas rigs drug gi sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus sa bon phyag mtshan dang bcas pa la thim zhing yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po/ zhal gcig /phyag gnyis pa/ zhal 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa thugs kar 'dzin cing g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dku la brten pa/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ dar gyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs can/ mtshan dang dpe byad thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ ye shes pa dang dbyer med cing rigs lngas dbu brgyan pa/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūm̐ yig dkar po'i mthar yi ge brgya pa'i sngags phreng dkar po g.yas su bskor ba/ bdag nyid kyis yi ge brgya pa bzlas pa'i tshe sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa las 'od zer bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun bab/

rdo rje sems dpa'i sku'i dbyibs brgyud zhabs g.yas pa'i mthe bong gi rtse nas bab pa rang gi tshangs bug tu zhugs lus thams cad gang*/ tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas da lta'i bar du bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chags nyes ltung thams cad dud khu dang sol khu'i rnam par 'og sgo gnyis nas phyir thon te dag /lus shel gong phyis pa ltar gyur pa'i nang du bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis khengs par gyur par dmigs nas/ yi ge brgya pa dag gsal sgros ma nyams pa brgya phrag yan chad bzla/ bshags pa ni/ kye hoḥ dus gsum bzhugs pa'i rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*| |yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung mar bcas// rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams la sogs pa// dpang gyur tshogs rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ni rdo rje theg mchog sgor zhugs kyang*// 'khrul rmongs nga rgyal dregs pa'i dbang gyur zhing*// mi shes gti mug brjed ngas tshod yod kyis// dam tshig 'gal 'khrul nyams chags mthol lo bshags// slob dpon dmod dang rgyal ba'i bka' las 'das// mched la 'khu zhing 'gro la byams brtse spangs// byang chub sems nyams gzhan gzhung grub mtha' smad// gzhan la gsang sgrog phung khams lha la brnyas// dag pa'i chos la som nyi za ba dang*// gdug la byams shing stong nyid gnas la smad// dad ldan sun phyung dam rdzas legs ma bsten// bud med la brnyas sbom po brgyad nyams dang*// yan lag dam tshig rnams las 'gal zhing 'das// lha sgom sngags bzla ting 'dzin g.yel zhing 'byams// sku gsung thugs yon phrin las dam tshig spangs// dbang bzhi'i dam 'gal spyad dang mi spang dang*// blang dang shes bya bsgrub bya'i dam tshig tshogs// lnga phrag lnga ldan nyer lnga las 'das dang*// gzhan yang theg mchog gzhung nas gang gsungs pa'i// dam tshig khas len gong du che ba dang*// lag len chung zhing dbang za tshod yod dang*// thub chod dregs pas des 'ong des chog gis// ma tshang ma 'byor nyes ltung ci mchis pa// gnong ngo 'gyod do rgyal ba'i spyan sngar bshags// 'thol zhing bshags pas rab tu dag gyur nas// tshe 'di'i rkyen dang phyi ma'i rnam smin du// mi 'gyur tshangs pa'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol// zhes zhe thag pa nas gnong 'gyod kyis bshags mthar/

bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyob mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso bos bdag la skyobs// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rdo rje sems dpas/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa nyes ltung thams cad legs par dag go/ zhes gnang ba byin nas/ dgyes bzhin du 'od kyi rnam par zhu ba rang gi tshangs bug nas thim pas rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du gyur par bsam mo// gsum pa bskang ba ni/ dang po phyi'i mchod pas bskang ba ni/ hūm̐ */ stong gsum phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na// gtsang zhing gtsang mar rab sbyar ba'i// mchod yon ji snyed mchis pa kun// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī pañtsa shanta kro dha de wa sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ rol mo dang shapada'i bar sbyar ba dang*/ hūm̐ */ 'di na sna tshogs gzugs mchis kyi// gzugs kyi lha mos gzugs mchog 'dzin// nam mkha'i khams kun yongs bkang nas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs spyan la 'bul// snang stong gzugs kyi mchod pa ni// sgyu 'phrul gar gyis bzhes nas kyang*// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī pañtsa shanta kro dha de wa sa pa ri wā ra rū pa badzra pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du gzugs kyi gnas su/ sgra/ dri/ ro/ reg /chos/ spyan gyi gnas su/ snyan/ shangs/ zhal/ sku/ thugs/ snang stong gi gnas su/ grag stong*/ tshor stong*/ myong stong*/ bde stong*/ rig stong*/ rū pa'i gnas su/ shapad/ gandhe/ ra sa/ sparshe| dharma dhā tu/ zhes sbyar/ hūm̐ */ 'jig rten 'di 'am gzhan kun na// 'khor lo rin chen mchis pa kun// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol| |oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī pañtsa shanta kro dha de wa sa pa ri wā ra tsakra ratna pra tītstsha swāhā/

'khor lo'i gnas su/ nor bu/ btsun mo/ blon po/ glang po/ rta mchog /dmag dpon/ tsakra'i gnas su/ ma ṇi/ st+rī/ pu ru ṣa/ hasti/ tu raṅga/ khaḍga/ hūm̐ */ bkra shis rnam par rgyal ba'i rtags// 'khor lo dung dang padma dang*// gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dpal be'u// bum pa gser nyar bcas pa rnams// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī pañtsa shanta kro dha de wa sa pa ri wā ra aṣṭa maṅga la pra tītstsha swā hā/ gnyis pa nang gi mchod pas bskang ba ni/ hūm̐ */ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha rnams la// bka' gsang rmad byung mchod pa ni// dpa' bo 'bru bcud dza gad chang*// tshil chen mar me sha chen spos// dbang po'i me tog rakta'i chab// bdud rtsi'i dri dang rkang gling sgra// dri chen bshos dang dri chab rgyun// sha chen rakta byang chub sems// rang la gnas pa'i bdud rtsi lnga| |rtsa ba yan lag bcas pa rnams// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī pañtsa shanta kro dha de wa sa pa ri wā ra ma hā pū dza pra tītstsha swā hā/ gsum pa gsang ba'i mchod pas bskang ba ni/ hūm̐ */ padma can dang dung can ma// ri dwags can dang glang sna can// de la sogs pa'i phyag rgya mchog /mtshan ldan gzugs sgra dri ro reg /chos nyid rnam dag dga' ba bzhi'i// mchod pa bde stong rmad byung ba// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol| |oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī pañtsa shanta kro dha de wa sa pa ri wā ra pañtsa mu dra a nu rā ga ya pra tītstsha swā hā/ bzhi pa de kho na'i mchod pas bskang ba ni/ hūm̐ */ lha dang bdag dang mchod pa dang*// mchod bya mchod byed la sogs pa// gnyis su 'dzin pa gang dang gang*// 'di na kun bzang rdzogs pa che// mnyam nyid 'ub chub thig le'i klong*// mtha' bral 'byams klas ka nas dag

/'khor gsum gdod nas rang dag pa// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī pañtsa shanta kro dha de wa sa pa ri wā ra ma hā sa masta pū dza pra tītstsha swā hā/ lnga pa khyad par gyi mchod pas bskang ba la/ sman snod lag g.yon du thogs/ g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis thigs gtor 'bul zhing*/ hūm̐ */ mtshan dang ldan pa'i bhandha ru// rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsis bkang*| |dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī pañtsa shanta kro dha de wa sa pa ri wā ra sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta pra tītstsha swā hā/ hūm̐ */ kun gzhi klong yangs bhandha ru// byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis bkang*// dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul| |thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī pañtsa shanta kro dha de wa sa pa ri wā ra sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta pra tītstsha swā hā/ hūm̐ */ mdangs gsal 'bar ba'i bhandha ru| |ye shes dri med bdud rtsis bkang*// dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī pañtsa shanta kro dha de wa sa pa ri wā ra sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta pra tītstsha swā hā/ hūm̐ */ mchog gi 'od gsal bhandha ru// thig le 'bar ba'i bdud rtsis bkang*// dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī pañtsa shanta kro dha de wa sa pa ri wā ra sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta pra tītstsha swā hā/ hūm̐ */ ye shes rtsa lnga'i bhandha ru// a dkar skye med bdud rtsis bkang*// dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī pañtsa shanta kro dha de wa sa pa ri wā ra sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta pra tītstsha swā hā/

hūm̐ */ ye shes 'bru lnga'i bhandha ru// shes rab rang gsal bdud rtsis bkang*// dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī pañtsa shanta kro dha de wa sa pa ri wā ra sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta pra tītstsha swā hā/ rakta'i snod lag g.yon du thogs/ g.yas pas 'phyar zhing*/ hūm̐ */ skra dang bcas pa'i bhandha ru// rgyu rkyen sbyar ba'i raktas bkang*// dmar chen rakta'i mchod pa 'di// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī pañtsa shanta kro dha de wa sa pa ri wā ra ma hā rakta pra tītstsha swā hā/ hūm̐ */ spyi bo bde chen bhandha ru// sdug bsngal rtsa yi raktas bkang*// dmar chen rakta'i mchod pa 'di// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru= ma hā rakta pra tītstsha swā hā| hūm̐ */ mgrin pa longs spyod bhandha ru// sna tshogs yid kyi raktas bkang*/ dmar chen rakta'i mchod pa 'di// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol| |oṃ gu ru= ma hā rakta pra tītstsha swā hā/ hūm̐ */ snying kha chos kyi bhandha ru// bsam pa blo yi raktas bkang*// dmar chen rakta'i mchod pa 'di// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul| |thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru= ma hā rakta pra tītstsha swā hā/ hūm̐ */ lte ba sprul pa'i bhandha ru// nyon mongs dug lnga'i raktas bkang*// dmar chen rakta'i mchod pa 'di// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru= ma hā rakta pra tītstsha swā hā/ hūm̐ */ gsang gnas bde skyong bhandha ru// bde ba thig le'i raktas bkang*// dmar chen rakta'i mchod pa 'di// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī pañtsa shanta kro dha de wa sa pa ri wā ra ma hā rakta pra tītstsha swā hā/

mthar sman rakta gtor ma rnams la sbreng ngo*// dpal gtor lag gnyis kyis bteg ste/ hūm̐ */ bhandha 'bar ba'i gtor gzhong du// ba liṃ rgyan ldan dpal bshos btsugs| |'dod yon sna tshogs mtheb skyu bsgron// mchi med bcud kyi dza gad gsal// dbu phreng rgyas pa'i raktas brgyan// rmad byung rdzas mchog gtor ma 'di// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī pañtsa shanta kro dha de wa sa pa ri wā ra ma hā ba lingta pra tītstsha swā hā/ hūm̐ */ gdal khyab pags pa'i gtor gzhong du// rus pa rang gsal dpal bshos btsugs// rang snang sha yi mtheb skyu bsgron/ bkrag dang mdangs kyi dza gad gsal// khrag dang chu ser raktas brgyan| |rmad byung rdzas mchog gtor ma 'di// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru= ma hā ba lingta pra tītstsha swā hā/ hūm̐ */ nyi zla ga'u'i gtor gzhong du// tsitta 'bar ba'i dpal bshos btsugs// padma 'dab brgyad mtheb skyu bsgron// rnam shes tshogs brgyad dza gad gsal// rtsa chen bzhi yi raktas brgyan// rmad byung rdzas mchog gtor ma 'di// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru= ma hā ba lingta pra tītstsha swā hā/ hūm̐ */ khog pa stong pa'i gtor gzhong du// mchin pa rang snang dpal bshos btsugs// glo mtsher mkhal ma'i mtheb skyu bsgron// guhya nang khrol dza gad gsal// rang snang mkhris pa'i raktas brgyan// rmad byung rdzas mchog gtor ma 'di// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru= ma hā ba lingta pra tītstsha swā hā/ hūm̐ */ dung khang 'bar ba'i gtor gzhong du// shangs kyi rlung sgrom dpal bshos gtsugs// 'khor lo 'bar ba'i mtheb skyu bsgron// sgron me mig gi dza gad gsal// dbang po rnam lnga'i raktas brgyan// rmad byung rdzas mchog gtor ma 'di// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī pañtsa shanta kro dha de wa sa pa ri wā ra ma hā ba lingta pra tītstsha swā hā|

tshogs bteg ste/ hūm̐ */ rin chen 'bar ba'i tshogs gzhong du// bza' btung sna tshogs tshogs su sbyar// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol| |oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī pañtsa shanta kro dha de wa sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pra tītstsha swā hā/ hūm̐ */ snod kyi 'jig rten tshogs gzhong du// bcud kyi skye 'gro tshogs su sbyar// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru= ga ṇa tsakra pra tītstsha swā hā/ hūm̐ */ rab yangs pags pa'i tshogs gzhong du// sha rus khrag gi tshogs su sbyar// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru= ga ṇa tsakra pra tītstsha swā hā/ hūm̐ */ byang khog yangs pa'i tshogs gzhong du// don snod sna tshogs tshogs su sbyar// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru= ga ṇa tsakra pra tītstsha swā hā/ hūm̐ */ rig pa rang byung tshogs gzhong du// rig rtsal ma 'gag tshogs su sbyar// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī pañtsa shanta kro dha de wa sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhal zas bteg ste/ hūm̐ */ rin chen 'bar ba'i gzhong pa ru// 'bru sna'i bshos gtsang brjid ldan la// sna tshogs rgyan dang ldan pa 'di| |rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī pañtsa shanta kro dha de wa sa pa ri wā ra nai wi dya pra tītstsha swā hā/ hūm̐ */ mkha' dbyings mtha' bral gzhong pa ru// nyi zla gza' skar bshos gtsang la// rang rang rgyan dang ldan pa 'di// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol| |oṃ gu ru= nai wi dya pra tītstsha swā hā/

hūm̐ */ bar snang yangs pa'i gzhong pa ru// chu 'dzin na bun bshos gtsang la// rlan byed chu yi brgyan pa 'di// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul| |thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru= nai wi dya pra tītstsha swā hā/ hūm̐ */ 'khor yug lcags ri'i gzhong pa ru// ri rab gling bzhi'i bshos gtsang la// rtsi shing sman bcud brgyan pa 'di// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru= nai wi dya pra tītstsha swā hā/ hūm̐ */ snod kyi 'jig rten gzhong pa ru| |bcud kyi skye 'gro bshos gtsang la// chas gos sna tshogs brgyan pa 'di// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru= nai wi dya pra tītstsha swā hā/ hūm̐ */ sgyu ma lus kyi gzhong pa ru// nang khrol don snod bshos gtsang la// rtsa rlung thig le'i brgyan pa 'di// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru= nai wi dya pra tītstsha swā hā/ hūm̐ */ stong gsal sems kyi gzhong pa ru// rig pa rang byung bshos gtsang la// rang rtsal sna tshogs brgyan pa 'di// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru= nai wi dya pra tītstsha swā hā/ hūm̐ */ kun gzhi ka dag gzhong pa ru// lhun grub ma bcos bshos gtsang la// snang bzhi mthar phyin brgyan pa 'di// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī pañtsa shanta kro dha de wa sa pa ri wā ra nai wi dya pra tītstsha swā hā/ mar me bteg ste/ hūm̐ */ ratna 'bar ba'i kong bu ru// 'bru mar rtsi mar mar khus gtams// ras dkar srin gyi sdong bu la// byin za 'bar ba'i zhugs me sbar// 'di ni rmad byung 'od 'bar te// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī pañtsa shanta kro dha de wa sa pa ri wā ra ā lo kaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/

hūm̐ */ bhandha 'bar ba'i kong bu ru// zhun chen gsum gyi mar khus gtams// skra dang gos kyi sdong bu la// yi dwags me yi zhugs me sbar// 'di ni rmad byung 'od 'bar te// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru= ā lo kaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ hūm̐ */ gdal khyab pags pa'i kong bu ru// khrag zhag chu ser mar khus gtams// sha dang rus pa'i sdong bu la// bkrag dang mdangs kyi zhugs me sbar// 'di ni rmad byung 'od 'bar te// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru= ā lo kaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ hūm̐ */ tsitta 'bar ba'i kong bu ru// snying tshil dkar nag mar khus gtams// padma 'dab brgyad sdong bu la| |rnam shes tshogs brgyad zhugs me sbar// 'di ni rmad byung 'od 'bar te// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru= ā lo kaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ hūm̐ */ dwangs ma lnga yi kong bu ru// sgrib med 'od lnga'i mar khus gtams// don snying rnam lnga'i sdong bu la// 'gyu byed rtsal gyi zhugs me sbar// 'di ni rmad byung 'od 'bar te// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru= ā lo kaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ hūm̐ */ a wa dhū ti'i kong bu ru// rang gsal 'od kyi mar khus gtams// 'khor lo bdun brtsegs sdong bu la// byang chub sems kyi zhugs me sbar// 'di ni rmad byung 'od 'bar te// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru= ā lo kaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ hūm̐ */ mi shigs thig le'i kong bu ru// skye med ye shes mar khus gtams// rtsa phran bcu yi sdong bu la// sems nyid rang gsal zhugs me sbar// 'di ni rmad byung 'od 'bar te// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru=

|ā lo kaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ hūm̐ */ ye shes lnga yi kong bu ru// a dkar rtsa gcig mar khus gtams// ye shes 'od zer sdong bu la// shes rab 'bras bu'i zhugs me sbar// 'di ni rmad byung 'od 'bar te// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru= ā lo kaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ hūm̐ */ mchog gi 'od gsal kong bu ru| |mdangs gsal 'od kyi mar khus gtams// thig le 'bar ba'i sdong bu la// ye shes lnga yi zhugs me sbar// 'di ni rmad byung 'od 'bar te/ rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul| |thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru= ā lo kaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ hūm̐ */ kun gzhi klong yangs kong bu ru// chos kyi dbyings kyi mar khus gtams// byang chub sems kyi sdong bu la// sku lnga lhun grub zhugs me sbar// 'di ni rmad byung 'od 'bar te// rtsa gsum zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul// thugs dam bskangs la dngos grub stsol// oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī pañtsa shanta kro dha de wa sa pa ri wā ra ā lo kaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes 'bul/ gshin don yin na skabs 'dir lho sgo dang*/ gson po'i don dbang bskur byed na'ang dkyil chog don gnyis myur 'grub ltar skabs 'dir bya'o// bzhi pa smon lam gdab pa ni/ thal mo sbyar la/ hoḥ bde chen ye shes gsal ba rang byung gi// dkyil 'khor chen por rdo rje slob dpon dang*// thugs rje'i gdung 'tshob rig 'dzin rnal 'byor rnams| |dbyer med dgongs spyod dag par rgyas gyur cig /gang zhig rdo rje'i rig 'dzin bdag cag rnams// 'khor ba'i g.yang sa che las rab bsgral nas// bde gshegs rig 'dzin zhi khro'i zhal mthong tshe// 'khrul ba'i bag chags gting nas zad par shog /bdud rtsi sman dang ma chags rakta dang*// dam rdzas gtor ma 'dod yon longs spyod tshogs// snang gsal mar me zhi khro'i lha tshogs kyis// gcong rong gnas su nam yang mi gtong zhing*// dmyal sogs tsha grang bkres skom blun rmongs kyi// sdug bsngal bskal pa ngan pa kun bcom ste// 'og min gnas su rdo rje 'dzin par shog

/rab 'byams ye shes rgyal ba'i zhing khams su// skad cig ting 'dzin shugs kyis rab bgrod nas// rang snang zhi khro'i lha dang dbyer med du// phyir mi ldog pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog /gal te bar dor 'jigs snang sgra 'od zer// stong pa'i cho 'phrul ma 'gag shar ba na// rang ngo shes shing sems nyid rab brtan nas// kun gzhi dag pa'i klong du chud par shog /las dang bag chags mthug pos sems nyid la// rang dbang ma thob 'khrul pa'i lam shar na// bde gshegs rig 'dzin gdams pa'i ngo sprod rnams// skad cig nyid la dus der 'char bar shog /las kyi dbang gis rigs drug gnas rnams su// skye ba len pa'i snang ba shar ba na// snod bcud dag pa'i dkyil 'khor rab dga' bar// 'jug pa'i lam gyi gnas ngan spong bar shog /gang zhig las kyi bag chags mthu btsan pas// rigs drug gnas su 'khyams par gyur srid na// khang bzang nang du lha mi'i lus bzung nas// che btsun chos kyi rigs su skye bar shog /skyes ma thag tu dam chos 'dul ba dang*// mdo sde ston pa'i bshes gnyen dam pa dang*// legs par phrad nas blang dor gnas rnams la// tshul bzhin dad pas chos bzhin spyod par shog /khyad par rdo rje theg mchog dkyil 'khor du// dbang bskur ston pa'i rdo rje slob dpon dang*// myur du phrad nas bskyed rdzogs rnal 'byor la// goms pa'i stobs kyis lam lnga mthar phyin shog /sa bcu rim bsgrod rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs// thun mong ma yin sngags kyi ye shes las// mngon byang chub pa'i sa mchog nyi shu gcig /skal bzang dag gis myur du bgrod par shog /mdor na dal 'byor mchog thob rab tu byung*// byang sems mthar son bskyed rim brtan pa thob| |rdzogs chen snang bzhi'i ye shes mthar son nas// sangs rgyas 'od phung chen po'i sa thob shog /ces dang*/ gzhan yang smon lam gang shes gdab bo// yon bdag gam gshin don yin na smon lam gyi gang zhig rdo rje'i rig 'dzin bdag cag rnams zhes pa'i bdag cag rnams kyi mal du de'i ming bcug go// gsum pa mjug ni/

tshogs la longs spyad/ lhag ma btang ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor pa'i gtang rag mchod bstod/ gshegs bsdu/ rtsa gsum las byang gi bskul/ chad tho/ brtan skyong*/ shis brjod sogs gzhung ltar bya zhing*/ mchod pa rnams bya khyi bud med sogs mi la mi sbyin bar gtsang sar gshegs/ las kyi rjes mi mngon pa bya'o// de ltar dam chos dgongs pa yang zab kyi zhi khro rigs bsdus kyi lhan thabs skong bshags na raka dong sprug gi cho ga bsdus pa 'di'ang*/ skal pa dang ldan pa sgrib gnyis sbyong bar 'dod pa rnams la sman pa'i bsam pas ring mo zhig nas sbyor bar sems kyang rnam g.yeng rgyud dal gyi ngang du lus pa/ slar yang rang gi grwa slob 'ga' zhig gis kyang bskul zhing*/ lhag par gad la 'or nas chos mdzad rin chen phan bdes nan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ 'bri gung pa shākya'i dge slong chos kyi grags pas/ shing khams lug gi lo gro bzhin can gyi dmar po'i stong pa gsum pa rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa ratna'i zhabs dag pa'i zhing gzhan gyi gdul bya 'dul bar gshegs pa'i dus dge bar/ 'bri klung rtse ba gzhis ka sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu mgyogs par sbyar ba'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
